response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ByteRate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(ByteRate) AS AvgRate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.ByteRate, r.ByteRate - a.AvgRate AS AboveAverageBy FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.ByteRate > a.AvgRate ORDER BY r.ByteRate DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by MediaType.Name, so same-named media type rows are combined. Tracks are linked to a media type through the inner join on MediaTypeId. Tracks with NULL Bytes add nothing to the byte total, but their Milliseconds still count toward the time total.

alternatives.interpretation: Only tracks with a non-NULL Bytes value count toward both totals, so tracks with unknown size are excluded from the milliseconds denominator as well.
alternatives.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ByteRate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(ByteRate) AS AvgRate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.ByteRate, r.ByteRate - a.AvgRate AS AboveAverageBy FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.ByteRate > a.AvgRate ORDER BY r.ByteRate DESC;
